title: Disk usage above threshold
description: A filesystem on the host has crossed its usage threshold.
likely_causes: Log rotation failed or is misconfigured
Temp or cache files not cleaned up
Genuine data growth
diagnostic_checks: Check which directories grew in the last 24h
Check whether log rotation ran on schedule
action_conditions: Auto-resolve if usage dropped back below threshold within 15 minutes (transient spike). Escalate if usage is above 95% or still rising.

title: Sustained high CPU utilisation
description: CPU utilisation on the host has stayed above threshold for the alert window.
likely_causes: Traffic spike
Runaway process or tight loop after a deploy
Scheduled batch job
diagnostic_checks: Check the top processes by CPU
Check whether a deploy or batch job started in the window
action_conditions: Auto-resolve if it coincides with a known scheduled batch job or has already recovered. Escalate if above 95% for more than 30 minutes or latency SLOs are affected.

title: Service health check failing
description: The service's health endpoint is failing on all instances.
likely_causes: Crash loop after a bad deploy
Dependency (database, cache, downstream API) unavailable
Expired credentials or certificate
diagnostic_checks: Check recent deploys for the service
Check the health of the service's dependencies
action_conditions: Always escalate; a full outage is never auto-resolved or suppressed.

title: Database replica lagging behind primary
description: Replication lag on a database replica has exceeded its threshold.
likely_causes: Long-running write transaction or bulk load on the primary
Replica under-provisioned for current write volume
Network degradation between primary and replica
diagnostic_checks: Check for long-running transactions on the primary
Check replica I/O and CPU saturation
action_conditions: Escalate; stale reads can corrupt downstream decisions. Lag that recovered within 5 minutes during a known bulk load may be noted as transient.

title: TLS certificate nearing expiry
description: A TLS certificate is within its expiry warning window.
likely_causes: Automated renewal failed
Certificate managed manually and not yet renewed
diagnostic_checks: Check the renewal job's last run and result
action_conditions: Escalate if fewer than 7 days remain or renewal has failed. With 7 or more days remaining and renewal scheduled, auto-resolve.

title: Health check flapping
description: A health check is alternating between passing and failing without a sustained failure.
likely_causes: Health check timeout set too tight
Brief network blips
Instance under GC or I/O pauses
diagnostic_checks: Check the flap frequency over the last hour
Check whether user-facing error rates moved
action_conditions: Suppress if no user-facing error-rate change and the check never stayed failed for more than 2 minutes. Escalate if it turns into a sustained failure.

title: Memory usage growing without bound
description: Process memory has grown steadily across the alert window without levelling off.
likely_causes: Leak introduced in a recent deploy
Unbounded cache or queue
Traffic pattern change exposing an existing leak
diagnostic_checks: Check the memory growth slope against recent deploys
Check time remaining until the memory limit at the current rate
action_conditions: Escalate; the process will hit its memory limit and be killed. Restarts mask the leak rather than resolve it.
